candidates.exact_span: b. A description of how the pathogen reduction requirements are met (including site restrictions for Class B sludge, if applicable).
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether pathogen reduction documentation is required depends on interpreting 'if applicable' and the Class B sludge scope; that affects which monitoring/recordkeeping obligations apply and how missing pathogen-related evidence should be classified.

candidates.exact_span: c. A description of how the vector attraction reduction requirements are met.
candidates.computation_change_reason: This establishes a documentation/recordkeeping obligation whose applicability to a given facility or period must be resolved before determining required monitoring and how absent vector-attraction evidence should be treated.

candidates.exact_span: d. A description of how the management practices listed above in Section II.3 are being met.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Interpretation of which Section II.3 management practices are incorporated and when they apply changes which monitoring/recordkeeping duties are operative and whether missing related evidence is a required-but-unreported case or another no-data state.

candidates.exact_span: e. The recommended agronomic loading rate from the references listed in Section II.3.c. above, as well as the actual agronomic loading rate shall be retained.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Different readings of which Section II.3.c. references govern, and whether recommended versus actual loading rates are enforceable numeric limits, change applicable limit comparisons, retention/monitoring obligations, and the semantics of missing loading-rate data.

candidates.exact_span: f. A description of how the site restrictions in 40 CFR Part 503.32(b)(5) are met for each site on which Class B bulk sewage sludge is applied.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether a site involves Class B bulk sewage sludge and whether 503.32(b)(5) restrictions are triggered determines if this site-specific documentation is required and how absent restriction evidence should be categorized.

candidates.exact_span: h. A certification statement that all applicable requirements (specifically listed) have been met, and that the permittee understands that there are significant penalties for false certification including fine and imprisonment. See 40 CFR 503.17(a)(4)(i)(B) or 40 CFR Part 503.17(a)(5)(i)(B) as applicable to the permittees sludge treatment activities.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Choosing between 503.17(a)(4)(i)(B) and 503.17(a)(5)(i)(B) based on the permittee's sludge treatment activities changes which specifically listed requirements must be certified as met and therefore which obligations and missing-evidence cases are in scope.

candidates.exact_span: i. The permittee shall maintain information that describes future geographical areas where sludge may be land applied.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether this forward-looking recordkeeping duty applies to a selected facility or reporting period affects monitoring-obligation results and whether absence of such information reflects a required-but-missing record or a non-applicable expectation.

candidates.exact_span: j. The permittee shall maintain information identifying site selection criteria regarding land application sites not identified at the time of permit application submission.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Applicability hinges on whether land-application sites remain unidentified at permit submission; different readings change required monitoring/recordkeeping and how missing site-selection evidence is classified.

candidates.exact_span: k. The permittee shall maintain information regarding how future land application sites will be managed.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Interpretation of when future-site management information must be maintained affects which monitoring obligations are operative and whether missing data indicates an unmet requirement or unresolved applicability.

candidates.exact_span: The person who prepares bulk sewage sludge or a sewage sludge material shall develop the following information and shall retain the information indefinitely. If the permittee supplies the sludge to another person who land applies the sludge, the permittee shall notify the land applier of the requirements for recordkeeping found i n 40 CFR 503 .17 for persons who land apply.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether the permittee prepares sludge versus supplies it to another land applier, and who must retain records indefinitely, changes which party's monitoring/recordkeeping obligations are evaluated and how missing records are attributed.

candidates.exact_span: a. The location, by either street address or latitude and longitude, of each site on which sludge is applied.
candidates.computation_change_reason: This site-identification requirement is operative only where sludge land application occurs; resolving that scope changes required monitoring and the meaning of missing location records.

candidates.exact_span: c. The date and time sludge is applied to each site.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether application events occurred and how application timing is defined affects which monitoring periods require date/time records and whether absent timestamps represent no discharge, unmet obligations, or unresolved cases.

candidates.exact_span: d. The cumulative amount of each pollutant in kilograms/hectare listed in Table 2 applied to each site.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Table 2 defines the pollutants and units for cumulative loading records; interpretation of which Table 2 pollutants and limits apply to each site changes enforceable numeric comparisons, required pollutant tracking, and how missing cumulative-loading data is classified.

candidates.exact_span: e. The total amount of sludge applied to each site in metric tons.
candidates.computation_change_reason: This recordkeeping duty applies per application site; different readings of site boundaries or application events change whether the metric-ton total was required and how missing totals should be interpreted.

candidates.exact_span: g. A description of how the requirements to obtain information in §503.12(e)(2) are met.
candidates.computation_change_reason: What satisfies §503.12(e)(2) information-obtaining requirements is not self-evident from this span alone; different interpretations change which documentation is required and whether absent descriptions indicate unmet obligations or unresolved applicability.
